levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Answers are a few words or a single vague sentence with no example.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Most answers state a point and back it with one concrete example.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All five answers state a point, back it with an example, and connect it to the job.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Learner read answers directly from written notes.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Learner answered out loud in their own words, referring to notes only occasionally.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Learner answered fluently without referring to notes and adjusted naturally to follow-up.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Revised answer is nearly identical to the original despite feedback.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Revised answer clearly incorporates the specific feedback given.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Revised answer incorporates the feedback and the learner explains why the change makes the answer stronger.

lookFors: The one-sentence warm-up notes show the learner had a starting point for every question before practicing.
The revised answer is visibly different from what the warm-up note suggested, not a copy of it.
The reflection names a specific question, not 'they were all hard.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
